en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a quiet European village canal or small river. On the left stands a plastered two‑ or three‑storey house with shuttered windows and a steep tiled roof. Trees and ivy grow along the bank and beside a dirt path that runs alongside the water. In the background, a small arched stone or brick bridge with railings crosses the canal, leading toward more gabled houses. A tall conifer tree stands on the right side, and the still water reflects the buildings and trees, giving a calm rural impression. Some faint signage is visible on the facade of a house beyond the bridge.
